# SEED_CREDENTIALS — LawDocsComply (LDC) — supplied by the pack lead, 26 October 2026 (run id ldc-seed-20261026-lead)

> **Gitignored and blocked by repository ruleset.** Do not paste into chats, tickets, wikis, commit messages, pull requests or logs. Claude Code never echoes, `cat`s or prints this file into a transcript; tests read credentials from the seed vault at runtime through the `SECRETS` port, never from test code.
> **Valid for environments:** local, dev, test, demo, staging. **Production never uses this file** (NN-61; IPB-11-14; `LDC-ENG-010`): the super admin is created in production by invitation link only, and the first production login forces a password change and MFA enrolment (`LDC-ENG-011`; IPB-D-04).
> **Rotation:** `pnpm seed:credentials --rotate` regenerates every password (24+ characters, CSPRNG, unique per persona and product — IPB-11 §11.4.7), writes the plaintext to `<SEED_VAULT_PREFIX>/<persona>` and rewrites this file with mode `0600`. Rotate on every staging refresh, on any suspected exposure, and before any demo to a third party. In `staging` and `demo` every seeded persona is created with `temporary=true` so the first login forces a change.
> **Source of the values below:** credentials supplied by the pack lead for LDC on 26 October 2026 (IPB-D-04). They were not generated by this pack's author and must not be altered by hand — rotate with the script.

## Demo narrative (profile `demo`)

"Demo Co" (`demo-co-nbfc`) is a fictitious NBFC-ML with a compliance team of three (admin, maker, checker), a CRO, one board member and an external auditor. Seeded: Scale Based Regulation obligations for an NBFC-ML from the RBI-NBFC family (synthetic CompIDs), one board pack for the quarter, two open internal-audit findings, one regulatory change awaiting re-mapping, three Vidhi schedules (weekly digest, monthly evidence-gap check, board-pack narrative on `BoardPackPublished`), the Vendor Assurance Room mirror with sample document metadata (no real certificates), and a published policy set from Appendix AD with placeholder entity particulars. All names, amounts and dates are synthetic and relative to the seed date. The same story runs across LawDocs, Equator, Finbyx, Udofin and the Operations Hub seeds (IPB-11 §11.4.8).

## Rules the seed script enforces

1. Refuse when `APP_ENV ∈ {prod, dr}` or `SEED_ENABLED != true` (exit 78; `LDC-ENG-010`).
2. Never log a password; stdout prints only `Wrote N credentials to ./env/SEED_CREDENTIALS.md (run <id>)`.
3. Register this path in `.gitignore` and `.git/info/exclude`; the repository ruleset blocks any file named `SEED_CREDENTIALS*`.
4. In `staging` and `demo`, set `temporary=true` in Keycloak so first login forces a change.
5. Emit `in.lawdocscomply.seed.CredentialsGenerated.v1` with counts only.
6. Append a row to the rotation log below.
